name: convergence-v2
description: Migración incremental de Convergence a PWA, Android, iOS y multijugador Firebase.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:core && npm run build:core:browser
scripts.build:profile:emulator: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:profile-emulator --workspace @convergence/client
scripts.build:functions:deploy: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:core && npm run build:deploy --workspace @convergence/functions
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:packages: npm run test --workspace @convergence/contracts && npm run test --workspace @convergence/game-core
scripts.test:functions:unit: npm run build:functions && npm run test:handler --workspace @convergence/functions
scripts.test:profile:build: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:profile-emulator-build --workspace @convergence/client
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only firestore,database,storage --project demo-convergence-v2 "npm run test:rules:run"
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:auth:emulator && npm run test:functions:emulator && npm run test:rules
scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:platform && npm run test:packages && npm run test:functions:unit
scripts.validate: npm run check:node && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:web
scripts.validate:full: npm run validate && npm run test:backend
scripts.emulators: npm run build && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:start --project demo-convergence-v2
scripts.emulators:smoke: npm run build && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-convergence-v2 "node scripts/smoke-emulators.mjs"
scripts.native:gate: npm run build:web && npm run native:gate --workspace @convergence/client
scripts.native:apk: npm run native:gate && npm run native:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug
